question: Which recent ISRO mission aims to explore the Sun-Earth Lagrange Point (L1)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aditya-L1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__

• **Aditya-L1** is the first dedicated **Indian space mission** designed to observe and study the **Sun** from a **halo orbit**.

• The mission is positioned at the **Lagrange Point 1 (L1)** of the **Sun-Earth system**, which is located about **1.5 million kilometers** away from Earth.

• The primary advantage of placing a spacecraft at the **L1 point** is that it allows for a continuous, unobstructed view of the **Sun** without any **occultation** or **eclipses**.

• **Chandrayaan-4** is a planned future mission by **ISRO** intended for **lunar sample return**, following the success of Chandrayaan-3.

• **Mangalyaan-2**, also known as **Mars Orbiter Mission 2 (MOM 2)**, is a proposed second mission to **Mars** to study its surface and atmosphere.

• **Astrosat-2** is envisioned as a successor to **Astrosat**, India's first dedicated multi-wavelength **space observatory**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The **Aditya-L1** mission was successfully launched on **September 2, 2023**, from the **Satish Dhawan Space Centre** in Sriharikota using the **PSLV-C57** rocket.

• The spacecraft carries **seven scientific payloads**, including the **Visible Emission Line Coronagraph (VELC)** and the **Solar Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope (SUIT)**.

• The mission objectives include studying **coronal heating**, **solar wind acceleration**, **coronal mass ejections (CMEs)**, and the dynamics of the **solar atmosphere**.

• **Lagrange Points** are specific positions in space where the gravitational forces of two large bodies (like the Sun and Earth) produce enhanced regions of attraction and repulsion, allowing a spacecraft to maintain a **stable position** with minimal fuel consumption.
